# Word merged-grid synthetic regression fixtures

Files are deterministic, synthetic QA documents from the user-provided Windows Word COM result `BUSINESS_NATIVE_QA_RESULTS(1).zip` (2026-10-15). No personal/private records. `source` is the original PyWPDoc-generated DOCX from that same run; `word_saved` is its Microsoft Word COM re-save. Each pair tests Word 1-row merged-band normalization without treating text/merge damage as valid.
